# `aitbc gpu register`

Register a GPU with the local GPU service, optionally with JSON specs.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc gpu register [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--gpu-id` | text | — | yes | The Gpu id. |
| `--specs` | text | — | no | GPU specifications (JSON string) - auto-discovered if not provided |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc gpu register --gpu-id <gpu_id>
```
